integrity_statement: Claims and computations are supported by a self-contained mathematical proof and a separate reproducible finite tester; independence and external certification are not asserted.
scientific_limitations: The characterization and enumerators determine only subsets of size at most n-2; a construction proves n-1 is the sharp failure threshold. The sparse-sensor limit fixes the number of layers while clique size grows. Finite computational checks do not prove all cases. Previously unindexed or differently formulated prior results may exist.
title: Sharp low-budget power domination on Cartesian clique paths
